Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For the record:
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We note your should-cost estimate and the proposed volume of 23,400 units over 24 months.
As a matter of policy, we do not disclose internal cost breakdowns.
Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: €31.70 per unit.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Please address any further questions in writing to this office.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For the record:
We acknowledge your revised offer and your acceptance of the 42-day lead time.
In response to your adjustment, we can reduce our price to €33.20 per unit for this package.
Further price reductions are not feasible under these parameters.
Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 42 days: €33.20 per unit.
These are our standard conditions for this product.
We will process your next message according to our standard procedure.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
